page.overview:
Who is Nianh?

Nianh is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah and former advisor to Queen Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu of Kandor.

She told Queen Ethenielle that the Kandori Spire was a remnant of the Age of Legends and probably harmless.

She disappeared without a trace after news of Elaida's deposition of Siuan Sanche and her subsequent ascension to the Amyrlin Seat, either returning to Tar Valon, recognizing Elaida, or joining the Rebel Aes Sedai in Salidar.
